title: Replace env vars that only carry detectable facts
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. SUSI_PUBLIC_IP, SUSI_MODEL_DIR, SUSI_XDG, SUSI_TURN_* and similar state something the host can detect. Detect first; keep the variable only as an override. Tests zc_env_detectable_*.
